search_log: Searched “Fredrik Backman My Friends 2025 excerpt publisher” and opened the official Simon & Schuster excerpt.

Searched “My Friends Fredrik Backman third person narrator,” “point of view,” and “alternating narration”; opened BookRags and LitCharts structural descriptions rather than relying on result snippets.
Opened the authorized eleven-page Chapter One PDF hosted by Better Reading; it duplicates the Simon & Schuster opening and was not counted as independent evidence.

Searched the exact first-person wording from q09759; no source recovering its local context surfaced. Google Books provided only metadata, catalog language, and a limited-preview link, so it was not used as person evidence.
Reviewed review and timeline results; sources describing alternating present and past timelines did not indicate any alternation in grammatical person.
person_note: The publisher's sustained opening and several Goodreads event passages consistently show an external narrator moving among Louisa, Ted, and other characters, while two independent whole-book guides explicitly identify third-person narration. Generic we/you aphorisms are nondiagnostic. The isolated first-person recollection in q09759 and other unattributed first-person fragments are local speech, thought, or clipped material rather than sustained first-person sections. The book alternates timelines and focal characters, but the evidence does not show alternation of narrative person.
